claims.statement: PM-407 was wet clean with wall buildup removed and showerhead new with 5 dummy wafers run pre-PM recipe 62.37 s baseline 60.0 s
PM-220 with wet clean showerhead replaced and 5 dummy wafers had first wafers vs later -0.63 A and slope -0.89 A per lot while PM-188 with skipped seasoning had -7.16 A
Reference wafer certified 500.0 A MET01 reads 499.66 A MET02 reads 499.99 A difference 0.33 A checked 5.4 hours ago
Monitor 1 at 60.0 s on MET02 gave 491.9 A implied rate 8.1983 A per s with 1 runs since PM
Monitor 2 at 60.0 s gave 491.49 A implied rate 8.1915 A per s with 2 runs since PM
Estimated rate 8.1949 A per s needs 61.01 s change -2.18 pct pre-PM time would give 511.12 A

notes.text: Starting recovery on DEP02-A — pulling the PM brief to identify risks.
Wet clean plus new showerhead — rate likely shifted and early drift expected. Checking history for seasoning and drift patterns.
History points to new-showerhead drift like PM-220. Checking metrology matching next.
Metrology looks matched, and old recipe would run thick after the clean. Running a monitor at baseline to measure the true rate.
First monitor came out thin at 491.9 Å — repeating at the same time to confirm the rate before adjusting.
Two monitors agree the chamber is running thin — estimating the corrected recipe to hit 500 Å.
Rate is stable and metrology is clean — releasing the chamber with the corrected time and drift compensation.
Release needs a small claim fix — correcting and resubmitting.

truth.explanation: A new showerhead coats fast at first: film thins about 0.89 A per lot. Plain EWMA on half the lots lags behind.
